g.text: Pub/sub fans out to all API instances.
Health, authority and coverage are separate.
Failback: adsb.fi HEALTHY + 5 min on OpenSky.
Lease guards instances; it does not fence Kafka.
SIGNAL_LOSS counts the entity owner’s provider
coverage since last_seen_ms. Downtime adds nothing.
Missing / unreadable timeline skips signal loss.
Evaluator has no TimescaleDB or Neo4j dependency.
Solid arrows: implemented paths. Dashed arrows: planned paths.
Reference-route tables belong to the planned deviation path.
CP4: structured JSON logs across all five backend services.
CP5: bounded datastore /healthz checks; Kafka health is out of scope.
CP6: make lag reads committed offsets and broker log ends via rpk.
